description: Convert a puzzle hash to a bech32m Chia address (xch1... for mainnet, txch1... for testnet11). Pure local computation, no RPC call. If you supply a prefix that differs from the configured network (e.g., txch on mainnet), the result includes a warning field — cross-network encoding is allowed but may indicate intent to send to the wrong network. Always use address_decode to validate the prefix before querying the chain.

prefix.description: Address prefix: 'xch' for mainnet, 'txch' for testnet11. Defaults to current network's prefix.

puzzle_hash.description: The puzzle hash to encode (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex)

name: address_encode
